in_sanskrit.name: Pravinsinh
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of the Gods
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Pravinsinh एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Pravinsinh is a compound name derived from 'Pravin' and 'Singh'. Pravin means 'Lord of the Gods' and Singh means 'Lion'. Pravinsinh, therefore, signifies a powerful, courageous, and strong leader who is revered and respected by all.
